findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-601.11: The gasket of the walk-in cooler is observed to have an accumulation of mold/soil. Ensure this gasket is properly cleaned and sanitized and then cleaned and sanitized at a frequency necessary to maintain it clean.
4-601.11: (B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.12: The floor and wall behind the oven is observed to have an accumulation of dust/debris. Once the oven is cooled off, these surfaces will need to be cleaned and then cleaned at a frequency necessary to maintain them clean. 
6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:

6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: In-use food dispensing utensils properly stored.
findings.comment:
Observed the scoop handle extended into the bulk container of flour. Scoop handles should be extended out of food at all times.
750-280 Food dispensing utensils shall be stored in the food with the handle extending out of the food; or stored clean and dry; or stored in running potable water dipper wells.

Sanitizer bucket tested at 0ppm Quat. Sanitizer bucket should test at 200-400ppm Quat.

findings.title: Presence of insects/rodents.  Animals prohibited
findings.comment: Observed 6 house flies and 3 fruit flies in donut display case. Flies were observed on the donuts. Donuts were voluntarily discarded and display case was opened and flies were removed to correct the violation. Discussed with store director and bakery manager about ways to prevent flies from entering display case. Store director noted they may try fans to act as a air curtain within the display case. Facility will contact their pest control operator and to treat for flies. Also, 1 fruit fly was observed coming out of the floor drain next to the walk in freezer. During next pest control service, make sure operator specifically treats drains for fruit flies. 750-1160 Effective measures to minimize the presence of rodents and insects shall be utilized. Provide effective pest control.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
Observed floor drain  next to walk in freezer to be soiled with an accumulation of dirt. Clean drain.
750-1200 All floors must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean floors.
